name: AQUATIC
description: You can breathe and move quickly through water, and suffer no other issues that aquatic environments bring.

name: CLOUT
description: Your name or wealth carries weight in the right circles. Each session, you have a 3d Favor resource pool. You can ask for a reasonable favor from those in power and roll the pool to have it granted. If it drops to 0d, you've asked too much. You can get what you want anyway by burning that bridge.

name: CROWD FAVORITE
description: Given time and space to entertain a crowd, you and participating allies can take spark for the performance. Give a vignette, then make a story roll to see how it goes.

name: CULTURAL WEAPON
description: While using the iconic weapon of your society, you can push yourself to pull off a potent feat of prowess using one of the styles. These weapons are often highly coveted outside of your ancestral lands.

name: FLIGHT
description: You have the ability to fly. Choose two of the following benefits that define this ability: Agile - Strong - Swift - Tireless. Be mindful of what you carry; most fliers can't bring much with them.

name: PINT-SIZED
description: Your slight frame has its advantages. Given time, you can pull off a potent feat of stealth or escape. You can push yourself to do it on the spot.

name: REGENERATION
description: When a scene ends while you are bloodied or desperate, make a 2d story roll as a defense against the harm. On a messy, reduce 1 harm to a mark. On a perfect, clear it. Choose a weakness that accompanies this power, such as: fire - iron - sunlight.

name: SALT OF THE EARTH
description: You have the air of someone with humble beginnings. The GM judges an NPC's response, or you can spend thread to set it: disdain - under-estimation - kindred - pity. When you go out of your way to help the common folk, take spark.

name: SIMPLE DEDUCTION
description: Once per session when trying to solve a question or puzzle to give a specific guess. The GM will tell you: something right about it - something wrong about it - a detail you missed. Use a story roll if the answer is unclear.

name: TEAMWORK
description: Time in a squad or crew taught you to work well with others. When you assist a roll and share the risk, your 5s count as 6s. When taking part in a group montage roll, your 6 result counts towards a critical success.

name: THIEVES' CANT
description: You and those you teach can communicate subtly in company, silently over distances, and through signs and markings. When you get a perfect deceiving others, you also setup an ally following your lead.
